title: Applying this sphere and its example splices
summary: Consult this sphere's rule documents (rules show) and articles before editing Python, and use the bundled example method splices as replacement_path inputs to source.python.method.edit for safe, single-method changes.
procedure: Open this article set with `gopher --profile python-best-practices context python-best-practices`.
Before a structural edit, prefer `gopher ... source.python.method.edit` so the change is AST-scoped; read article edits.preserve-unrelated-bytes first.
For a clean, tested reference body to replace into a method, read one of the examples/python-method/*.py.frag files in this activated archive and reference it as the replacement_path.

Verify with `gopher --profile python-best-practices rules check <file>.py --language python` to confirm the four statically-detectable core breaches stay clear, then re-read the module for the intent-based guides from this sphere.
invariants: A sphere never edits engine/gopher.py; added python rule documents are reference guidance surfaced by rules show, not extra executed rule-check breaches.
Example splices are one complete method each and are validated as a single class member before commit.
If Python artefacts in your checkout differ from these canonical bases, your checkout is authoritative for its own edits; this sphere is reference.
